options.codeIni.label: Initial code (codeini) - empty = use default
options.decimais.hint: Only results that already come out as floating point get rounded: an exact fraction (e.g. 23/20) is left as-is, so it doesn't break "simplify this fraction" exercises. To force decimal in a specific exercise, use matexe_decimal(...) inside the <MAT>/<EVAL>, e.g.: matexe_decimal(230*5/1000) → 1.15.
options.decimais.label: Number of decimal places in results
options.decimal.hint: Changes the default behaviour of EVERY <MAT>/<EVAL> in the document (same as wrapping each one in matexe_decimal(...)). Whole-number results are unaffected (4 still shows as 4, never 4.0) - only non-integer exact fractions get converted. A specific exercise can still do the opposite of this setting: matexe_decimal(...) forces decimal even with this off, matexe_fraccion(...) keeps the exact fraction even with this on.
options.decimal.label: Always show decimal, not exact fraction (recommended for physics/chemistry)

plantillas.ai.note: The AI returns the template in the editor below: review it (and try the preview) before saving. If there is already code written, it takes it as a starting point instead of starting from scratch.

plantillas.imagesHelp: They are saved with the template (not next to the document), so they work for any exam or quote, wherever the file is.
plantillas.intro: The template sets the layout (header, letterhead, margins); the document stays the same. It applies to the preview and to everything you export: PDF, LaTeX, Markdown, Word and OpenDocument.
plantillas.latexHelp: Write {{CORPO}} wherever you want the document to go. If you do not put \documentclass, Yang adds its usual preamble (enough for a header and footer); if you do, you are in charge and Yang only adds the packages needed by the plots and images. Put fixed data as variables {{CENTRO}}, {{MATERIA}}… {{DATA}}, {{ANO}}, {{TITULO}} and {{FICHEIRO}} already exist.
plantillas.markdownHelp: Same {{CORPO}} and same variables, but in Markdown. If you leave it empty, those three exports come out without a layout, as before. Images are referenced here as images/logo.png.
plantillas.name: Name
plantillas.needBody: {{CORPO}} is missing: without it Yang does not know where to put the document.
plantillas.noVars: No variables. Add one so a fixed piece of data (the school, the company…) can be changed without touching the LaTeX.
plantillas.noneDesc: The document comes out with Yang's default layout.
